data:
投喂了池鳞，竟被弹射出八丈远！为了让池鳞满意，这些游客吸取教训，积极反思——决定奋力研制更大、更香甜的饵。
<@rolv.rem>场地中有夺取后回复周围友方单位技力的<“冰淇淋机”></>
<@rolv.rem>场地中有阻挡敌人的<城防路障></>

池の鱗獣に餌をやったら、物凄い勢いで吹き飛ばされてしまった！池の鱗獣を満足させるため、観光客たちは教訓から学び、大いに反省した――そしてより大きく、より美味しい餌の開発に取り組むことを決めた。
<@rolv.rem>制御権を奪取すると、周囲の味方ユニットのSPを回復する<「ジェラート供給所」>が出現</>
<@rolv.rem>敵をブロックできる<都市防衛柵>が出現</>

After trying to feed the fins in the pond, some tourists were knocked eight zhang away! In order to satisfy those fins, they learned from their mistakes and reflected on the past... deciding to do all they can to develop bigger, sweeter bait. <@rolv.rem><'Gelato Stops'> are present on the field that restore allied SP when captured <@rolv.rem> are present on the field that Block enemies
【鸭爵金币】固定出现<圆仔>，且提早出现
N18追加敌人：寻路者突击手×8、寻路者阵地撕裂者×6
【鴨爵の金幣】隠し敵が<マルッコ>に固定され、出現が早くなる
18難：＜求道強襲者＞8体、＜精鋭求道ブレイカー＞6体が追加で出現
Duck Coin - bonus enemy fixed to summon Fatty, and appears earlier
D18: Additional 8 <Pathfinder Veles> and 6 <Pathfinder Ballistarius Prefect> appear
所有敌方单位的攻击力，防御力，生命值+40%
糖果车和节日零食车的攻击力和生命值额外提升至150%
战斗开始时额外出现1个雕伥，每15s召唤一个节日零食车
敵全員の最大HP・攻撃力・防御力+40%
<祝祭のおやつカート>の最大HPさらに+50%
戦場中央下段エリアに「彫鬼」が出現、15秒ごとに<祝祭のおやつカート>を召喚する
All enemy units have +40% ATK, +40% DEF and +40% Max HP
<Carnevale Snack Cart> has additional +50% Max HP
Additional 1 Statuegeist appears and summons 1 <Carnevale Snack Cart> every 15s
求道デザートショップ
Reflect some damage taken, gives +4 Originium Ingots when defeated
Grants a marking buff to friendly units within range (ignores camouflage)

Grants a buff to enemies within skill range, granting ASPD +50, Movespeed +50% for 15s (target must re-enter skill range in order to receive buff benefits again
Enemies with this buff receive 75% less damage from unmarked friendly units
Consumes 20 DP to force the Statuegeist to close its mouth and stopping spawning enemies for a period of time
Less likely to be attacked, and restores 75 HP per second
